finding.guards_checked: Signature verification is skipped on this path. The header parser does catch RecursionError (jwt/api_jws.py:360), so the handling is inconsistent. No payload size limit. Impact: apps that catch PyJWTError to return 401 get an unhandled exception (typically 500) from one unauthenticated request.

finding.claim: [medium, when cache_keys=True] The lru_cache wrapper on get_signing_key has no TTL, so a key removed from the JWKS (revoked or rotated out) keeps verifying tokens in that process until it is evicted by 16 other kids.
finding.source: A token whose kid matches a previously cached key, signed with that key's private half (e.g. a leaked or revoked key).
finding.sink: Signature verification with the stale PyJWK at jwt/api_jws.py:416-417 and 432.

finding.guards_checked: Documented in the docstring (jwt/jwks_client.py:69-72, 'no time-based expiration'). Default is cache_keys=False. Only LRU eviction removes entries. Exploitation needs possession of the revoked key's private half.

finding.claim: [low] The refresh cooldown only applies when jwk_set_cache is set. With cache_jwk_set=False, each token with an unknown kid triggers two outbound JWKS HTTP fetches before any signature check, which is an unauthenticated request-amplification path against the JWKS endpoint.

finding.sink: Outbound HTTP via urllib opener.open in fetch_data (jwt/jwks_client.py:156-162), called twice per unknown kid.

finding.guards_checked: Cooldown is documented as bypassed when cache_jwk_set=False (jwt/jwks_client.py:66-67). Cooldown is on by default when the cache is enabled. The timeout is 30s. Signature validation happens only after lookup.

finding.guards_checked: Canonical base64url round-trip (jwt/api_jws.py:338-339). Exact length check (utils.py:87-88). Curve check (algorithms.py:716-725). None of these stop malleability. finding.claim: [low] The iss claim is not checked when the issuer argument is omitted (fail-open), while aud fails closed when audience is omitted (api_jwt.py:522-527). Apps that forget issuer= accept tokens from any issuer whose signature validates under the configured key.
